notes: Albums is your library again. 58.9.6 started treating an album as yours only if it carried a stamp written by a hand-made action — and every album made before that stamp existed carries no marker at all, so a library of twelve hand-made albums was drawn as a single card. An album is now held back from Albums only when it is recorded as one the app created by itself (the old card-drag auto-save, or a tag album materialised so a reorder had somewhere to live). Nothing was ever deleted — your albums and their songs were in storage the whole time, and they are listed again now

Singles is back to the list it has always been. 58.9.6 also merged in each artist’s own release list on top of the song search, which pulled in releases the song search never returned — reported as well over a hundred songs appearing in Singles that are not the user’s artists. The song search alone is what builds the list again, and the one saved snapshot that still held those extra releases is dropped once so they cannot come back from the cache

Kept from 58.9.6, because it fixes a separate report: a refetch no longer deletes the singles it is about to refetch, the Discover button and the refetch share one saved list, and a per-artist refresh leaves the other artists alone. A failed fetch now says so instead of emptying the popup.
